findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "scan_evm_dust_and_hygiene" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_frontend_hijack · Private data: check_eip7702_delegation, check_solana_token2022, check_mcp_poisoning, audit_solidity_or_mcp, reclaim_solana_rent, scan_evm_dust_and_hygiene, build_erc20_approval_revoke, build_evm_dust_to_usdt_sweep, build_cross_chain_consolidation, analyze_token_alpha, create_usdt_invoice, verify_usdt_invoice · Public sink: check_tx_firewall, reclaim_solana_rent, build_evm_dust_to_usdt_sweep, build_cross_chain_consolidation, verify_usdt_invoice · Destructive: audit_solidity_or_mcp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_frontend_hijack · Private data: check_eip7702_delegation, check_solana_token2022, check_mcp_poisoning, audit_solidity_or_mcp, reclaim_solana_rent, scan_evm_dust_and_hygiene, build_erc20_approval_revoke, build_evm_dust_to_usdt_sweep, build_cross_chain_consolidation, analyze_token_alpha, create_usdt_invoice, verify_usdt_invoice · Public sink: check_tx_firewall, reclaim_solana_rent, build_evm_dust_to_usdt_sweep, build_cross_chain_consolidation, verify_usdt_invoice · Destructive: audit_solidity_or_mcp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
